prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 78.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.3%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Path selection decision helper tip']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Card grid layout for path choice screen', 'Move sign-in step after adoption', 'Explicit desktop pet launching instructions on intro', 'Desktop ready notification prompt', 'Pet generation progress tracker screen', 'Photo upload quality guidance tip', 'Sign-in troubleshooting delay tip']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive preview stage layout for pet selection
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into an interactive stage layout where users can preview pet animations and reactions live before making their choice.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a high mean completion time of 1017s, indicating users struggle to evaluate pet options.

candidates.title: Desktop pet controls interactive guide screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive onboarding screen right before final intro demonstrating how to summon, move, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report user confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet on the desktop.

new_pet_controls.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_pet_controls.body: Click and drag to move your pet around your desktop. Right-click anytime for quick controls, speech, or to hide the pet.

components.text: Drag & drop to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk

candidates.title: Personality quiz guided path selection flow
candidates.change: Transform the path choice step into an interactive 2-question personality quiz flow that automatically recommends the best setup path.
candidates.why: choose_path drops 21.6% of users with an average time of 514s, showing users need guidance deciding how to proceed.

choose_path.headline: Find Your Perfect Pet Match
choose_path.body: Answer two quick questions to get matched with your ideal pet companion.

candidates.title: Desktop visibility verification checklist intro
candidates.change: Redesign home intro into a interactive checklist verifying that the pet is visible on screen and rendering properly.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report pets failing to show on desktop and 4 report feature misbehavior right after setup.

home_intro.headline: Desktop Setup Verification
home_intro.body: Confirm your pet is active and visible on your desktop before completing setup.

home_welcome.text: Pet rendered on screen | Sound enabled | Desktop overlay permission granted

candidates.title: Cloud save security reassurance on sign-in
candidates.change: Display a prominent cloud save reassurance note and security badge above sign-in buttons explaining that pets are tied to accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Your pet customization and progress are permanently linked to your account.

candidates.title: Ambient sound and tip carousel on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add calming ambient pet sound effects and an rotating tip carousel to keep users engaged while waiting for generation.
candidates.why: The waiting screen ('home' step) has high duration (mean 2336s, median 201s) leading to 18.7% drop-off.

components.text: Did you know? You can train your pet custom tricks later!

candidates.title: Adoption completion bonus reward badge
candidates.change: Add an instant unlock reward badge and cosmetic item preview to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (39.1% lost), so providing immediate perceived value boosts completion.

candidates.title: Account pet sync guarantee banner on sign-in
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to explicitly mention multi-device pet recovery and cloud backup persistence.
candidates.why: 8 support emails concern lost pets after sign-in; clear copy upfront builds trust and encourages account creation.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet
sign_in.body: Creating an account ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings are safe and recoverable anytime.

candidates.title: Quick adoption recommendation callout
candidates.change: Display an instant recommendation hint emphasizing the fastest path to get a pet on desktop.
candidates.why: 21.6% drop-off on choose_path with 514s mean time indicates choice paralysis.

choose_path.hint: Recommended for fast start: Select 'Quick Adopt' to get your desktop pet in under 60 seconds.

candidates.title: Live rendering status timer on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add live progress indicator components and visual rendering stages to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home step waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s; clear visual feedback reduces perceived delay.
